title: Supreme Court Clarifies Bail Standards Under UAPA Anti-Terror Law
detail: The Indian Supreme Court issued a significant clarification on bail standards under the Unlawful Activities Prevention Act (UAPA), India's primary anti-terror statute. The ruling addresses the stringent bail conditions that have kept many accused detained for extended periods without trial, potentially affecting hundreds of pending cases involving activists, journalists, and alleged militants.

media.caption: Supreme Court of India issues clarification on UAPA bail standards
